question: How does full learning-rate policy change the apparent benefit of weight EMA at fixed duration, and how do duration effects differ across policies?
hypotheses: EMA-minus-raw SW1 may depend on schedule policy and terminal duration; negative, null, and positive differences are valid.
No directional confirmatory hypothesis or mechanism is asserted.

design.constant_reuse: One 10000-step trajectory supplies the 5000 and 10000 states
design.cosine: Separate trajectories with horizon equal to selected duration; lr(step)=0.0003*(1+cos(pi*(step-1)/horizon))/2 for steps 1..horizon

fixed.model: Supplied reference Denoiser, all buffers retained
fixed.noise_schedule: Supplied cosine DDPM schedule offset 0.008, beta cap 0.999; x0 clip [-6,6]
fixed.ema: Copy initial raw weights, then lerp toward post-optimizer raw weights with 1-decay after every step; no warmup or bias correction

matching.initialization: torch.manual_seed(seed), CPU initialization then move to selected device
matching.training_prefix: NumPy default_rng(seed+100000): 10000x256 indices, then 10000x256x2 normal noise, then 10000x256 integer timesteps; all policies consume same prefixes
matching.generation: NumPy default_rng(seed+3000000), float32 shape (100,2048,2), shared across every cell/variant
matching.hashes: SHA256 contiguous array bytes; prefix hash concatenates indices[:5000] int64, noise[:5000] float32, timesteps[:5000] int64, training minibatch values[:5000] float32, in that order

metrics.primary: Reference Sliced Wasserstein-1 with 128 fixed unit directions, projection seed 7321, float64 evaluation
metrics.coverage: Nearest center within <=0.45, covered when count >= ceil(0.01*2048)=21; denominator all generated draws

contrasts.secondary: Same factorial contrasts of absolute SW1 for each variant; coverage and inlier summaries

uncertainty.unit: Independent training seed within dataset; four independent seeds. Conditions, variants, points, and directions are paired or nested, not new replicates.
uncertainty.primary: Two-sided unadjusted 95% Student t interval over seed-level paired differences and contrasts, df=3 for all four seeds; report all seed values
uncertainty.sensitivity: Exact two-sided sign-flip p-value over 2^n signs and leave-one-seed-out means; minimum p=0.125 for n=4
uncertainty.multiplicity: All intervals descriptive and unadjusted; no familywise discovery or best-decay claim
uncertainty.partial: No population interval for n<2; no full-study conclusion unless all 32 cells complete

qualification: SW1 identical/permuted samples=0; known translated point cloud agrees with analytic average projected translation
Coverage checks nearest-center, all-draw denominator and exact threshold
Model/state keys, float32, EMA initial copy and post-step recurrence
Short deterministic rerun, saved-weight sample regeneration, matched actual prefixes, LR endpoints and horizon distinction
Pilot throughput and full-2048 sampling measurement on seeds 71 and 81 only
device_rule: Qualify CPU and MPS float32; choose the faster supported backend from pilot timing without reference to quality. Same backend across confirmation cells. No tuning on confirmation.
